title: Company Directory Dataset
description: Seed dataset for the dev company directory. Nulls are first-class: a null means the underlying research did not establish the value, and must not be filled in with a guess.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when this dataset file was generated.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug derived from the name. Unique across the file; used as the merge key by the update script.

logoUrl.description: Root-relative path to a logo stored in this repo, e.g. "/logos/resend.png". The update script downloads the logo once and commits it, so the visitor's browser never requests a company's CDN. An https URL is permitted by the pattern but should not be used: a remote one would break the no-third-party-requests guarantee and the img-src 'self' CSP. Null when no logo is held.

description.description: One-line description of what the company does.

website.description: Full company URL including the https:// scheme, or null when no domain is known.

careersUrl.description: Careers page URL. Non-null only where the research explicitly recorded one.

sizeRange.description: The original free-text size from the research, preserved verbatim (e.g. "~45", "51–200", "1,000+", "Small, YC-backed"). Null when no size was recorded.

sizeMin.description: Parsed lower bound of sizeRange. Null when the free text carries no usable number (funding amounts and vague adjectives are never converted into headcounts).

sizeMax.description: Parsed upper bound of sizeRange. Null when unparseable or open-ended (e.g. "200+").

hqLocation.description: The location/remote string as recorded in the research, or the country for entries known only by country. Null when nothing was recorded.

country.description: Normalized country name only (e.g. "Estonia", "United States"). Null when the research does not unambiguously establish a country.

remotePolicy.description: Normalized working model. Null when the research recorded no policy or the signals conflict.

remoteRegions.description: Region strings extracted from the location text (e.g. "Americas", "Europe", "Global"). Empty when unknown.

keywords.description: Lowercase kebab-case domain and (only where the research names one) tech-stack tags. Tech-stack tags are never inferred for companies whose stack was not recorded.

currentOpenings.description: Open roles confirmed at verification time. Empty for every unverified entry and for roles that had already closed.

history.description: Append-only weekly scan log written by the update script. Always empty in the seed data — no synthetic history is shipped.

lastVerified.description: When the company's own careers page was last checked. Null for entries never verified against a primary source.

dataNotes.description: Plain-language honesty note about caveats in this record (closed roles, conflicting sources, unconfirmed listings, size disagreements, hiring restrictions). Null when there is nothing to flag.

openingsTotal.description: Roles the board listed before de-duplication and the per-company cap. Larger than currentOpenings means the stored list is a sample. Null when never scanned.

title.description: Role title as recorded, with salary details moved to the company's dataNotes.

url.description: Direct link to the role posting. Null in the seed data — no per-role URLs were recorded.

postedDate.description: Posting date. Null in the seed data — no posting dates were recorded.

detectedKeywords.description: Keywords derived from the role title only. Empty when the title implies no specific technology or discipline.

location.description: Where the role is advertised, as the job board states it. Null when the board gives no location.

weekOf.description: ISO date of the Monday of the scanned week.

openCount.description: Number of open roles seen in that week's scan.

keywordCounts.description: Per-keyword counts across that week's open roles.
